note: Gold for the US Contra manual, pages as OCR'd by tesseract from the gamesdatabase scan. Every row is a sentence a person can point at in the OCR text (manuals/pages/Contra_US). This is NOT the Japanese manual — scores do not mix with contra_j.json.

statement_keys.sensor-advance: To advance, wipe out the detection sensors at the end of each zone.
statement_keys.extra-life: Every stage successfully overcome grants one extra life.
statement_keys.fire-left: B shoots either left or right.
statement_keys.3d-forward-only: Defense Zones 2 and 4 are 3D: pad to move, B to fire, A to jump.
statement_keys.eight-zones: There are eight defense zones; the last is Red Falcon's lair.
statement_keys.capsule-weapons: Destroy flying capsules and pill-box sensors to release Falcon symbols.
statement_keys.start-pause: START begins the mission and pauses the action.
